name: rca-bench-factory
description: Turn non-standard enterprise telemetry into authoritative RCA benchmark field contracts.
_scripts_note: Every script that reads a build artefact declares the build as a `pre<script>` hook. pnpm runs
`pre<script>` automatically, so the precondition holds at every entry point -- the script, a bare
`pnpm run <script>`, and a CI step -- without any caller having to remember it.
This exists because the pipeline's step order used to be an unwritten precondition. `typecheck`
was green for months only because CI ran `Build` before it (finding 43). Fixing that one script
left the class intact: P2-1's cold-tree measurement later found three of the seven doc guards,
plus `lint`, `test`, `examples:check` and `official:check`, depending on the same unstated fact.
`pretypecheck` builds core alone, deliberately: cli's types resolve against core's declarations,
so type-checking cli needs core's dist and nothing else. Every other hook needs cli's dist too --
the doc guards drive it, and the example generator and official exporter reach through it -- so
The key is a plain manifest field rather than a comment because JSON has no comments; nothing
reads it but a human. `test/cold-tree-preconditions.test.ts` holds it to the manifest.
`check-no-unsafe-shell.mjs` is in `lint` rather than beside the other guards for the same reason
`check-no-absolute-paths.mjs` is: it reads text, it needs no build, and it must run on every push
because the defect it catches is silent in review.
